recruiting.probationDaysHint: Leave empty — value from the position, or 90 days
recruiting.nextContactHint: Leave empty if nothing is planned
recruiting.statusFilterHint: Hired, rejected and withdrawn candidates are not shown in this list — pick a status here to see them
recruiting.vacancyEmptyText: The funnel starts with a vacancy: every candidate belongs to exactly one opening.
recruiting.vacancyNotFoundText: Try changing the search or the filter.
recruiting.vacancyReopenNameTaken: Not reopened: an open vacancy with this title already exists — add new candidates to that one.
recruiting.systemVacancyHint: System vacancy — always open. Applications from the bot’s “Fill in the form” button land here.

vacancyAction.deleteText: The record is removed from the list (kept in the database). Use this ONLY for a record created by mistake — a typo, a test vacancy. A vacancy that already has candidates cannot be deleted: it is history and should be closed instead.

recruiting.candidateNotePlaceholder: Internal note: who referred them, what stands out
recruiting.candidateReasonHint: Internal note only — it is not sent to the candidate.
recruiting.candidateEmptyText: Add a candidate manually, or wait for the Telegram application bot.
recruiting.candidateNoRejectedText: Both the candidates we turned down and those who withdrew on their own land here, and nothing is deleted — you may revisit them in a future search.
recruiting.candidateNotFoundText: Try changing the search or the filters. Hired, rejected and withdrawn candidates are hidden by default — pick them in the “Status” filter.

candidateAction.rejectText: The COMPANY’s decision: the candidate leaves the funnel. The record is kept — you may revisit it in a future search.
candidateAction.withdrawText: The CANDIDATE’s decision: they walked away. This is deliberately separate from “we rejected” — in funnel reports they mean very different things.
candidateAction.reassignText: The candidate stays in the funnel, only the opening changes. The stage history is preserved.
candidateAction.deleteText: The record is removed from the list (kept in the database). Use this ONLY for a record created by mistake: a rejected candidate is kept — they are the base for a future search.
candidateAction.reserveText: The candidate leaves the pipeline, but this is NOT a rejection: “no opening right now, we will call them when there is”. The record stays in the list and returns to the pipeline in one action.
candidateAction.returnToFunnelText: The candidate returns to the funnel and continues from the stage where they stopped — the stage history is kept. The exit date and reason are cleared, but both stay in the stage timeline.
candidateAction.returnReasonHint: Why are we returning them — e.g. “reached out again, has more experience now”

recruiting.startStageHint: Leave empty and the candidate starts at the beginning of the funnel
recruiting.funnelNoStagesText: At least one active stage is required to draw the funnel. Configure them in “Reference data → Pipeline stages”.
recruiting.funnelDragHint: Press space bar to pick up the card. Use the left and right arrows to choose a stage, space bar to drop it, Escape to cancel.
recruiting.funnelDragStart: Card picked up. Choose a stage with the arrow keys.
recruiting.stageMoveHint: Each button opens a short form: date, outcome, conclusion and the next contact date.
recruiting.interviewText: On confirmation the candidate receives a Telegram invitation with the date, time, address and contact number. A sent message cannot be recalled.
recruiting.interviewNoTelegram: This candidate did not come through the bot — there is no Telegram address, so no message is sent. The interview time is stored on the card only.
recruiting.interviewNoteHint: Internal note only — it never reaches the candidate
recruiting.stagesEmptyText: Every interview, panel and phone call is recorded in this timeline.
recruiting.filesFullHint: The 10-file limit is reached — delete one before adding another
recruiting.filesUploadHint: PDF or image · up to 20 MB each. Images are downscaled on the server.
recruiting.filesDeleteText: The file is removed from both the database and the disk. This cannot be undone.
recruiting.acceptEffectEmployee: The candidate becomes an EMPLOYEE and their card appears in the Employees list.
recruiting.acceptEffectProbation: A probation period starts — they appear in the Probation list.
recruiting.acceptEffectVacancy: The vacancy’s “filled” counter increases by one.
recruiting.acceptPinflHint: Copied from the document on the hiring day; may be left empty
recruiting.acceptPersonalHint: Full name, birth date, phone and address are copied from the candidate — no need to re-enter them.
recruiting.acceptDoneHeading: The candidate is now an employee
recruiting.acceptDoneText: The employee card has been created and the probation period has started.
recruiting.hireFromReserve: The candidate is in reserve. They are first returned to the pipeline and then hired — for you this is a single action, nothing else is required.
recruiting.hirePinflWhy: The PINFL is deliberately kept in plain view: an existing employee is matched by exactly this number — leave it empty and a second card may be created for the same person.
recruiting.hireMoreHint: Everything here is optional — hiring works even if you never open it: every field has a server-side default.
recruiting.hireSalaryHint: Left empty — registered without a salary record
recruiting.hireCatalogEmpty: The legal entity or position list is empty — hiring is impossible without them. Add entries under “Catalogs”, or reload the page: the list may have failed to load.
recruiting.vacancyTitleHint: The name used in the job ad. This is not a company position — the position is chosen when the candidate is hired
recruiting.acceptPlacementHint: Which legal entity, department and position the candidate is hired into. The vacancy does not carry this — the decision is made here.
recruiting.vacancyOpenHint: Open vacancies only: closed ones do not accept candidates
recruiting.questionnaireHint: Answers the candidate filled in through the Telegram bot
recruiting.referralLabel: How they heard about the job
recruiting.photoDeleteText: The photo will be removed for good — the card falls back to initials.

reserveSection.emptyText: The “Move to reserve” action on a candidate card brings them here. They stay a candidate, not an employee.
reserveSection.notFoundText: No candidates in reserve match “{{query}}”. Try a different word.

recruiting.reserveSearchHint: More candidates matching this search in the “Reserve” section: {{n}}
recruiting.phoneMatchHint: Saving is not blocked — check the card to make sure it is not the same person.
recruiting.phoneMatchFailed: Could not check whether this number is already in the database — you can still save.

notifications.emptyText: Reminders about probation periods, birthdays and candidates will show up here.
notifications.confirmDeleteText: The selected notifications ({{n}}) will be removed from the list for good and will not come back — even if the condition still holds. The employee and candidate records themselves are untouched.
